title: CI/CD for AI Apps — Promote with Evidence and Roll Back with State
key_insight: Record a release manifest covering every component and migration. Design backward-compatible changes or paired rollback steps.
body:
## Promote with Evidence and Roll Back with State

A release changes prompts, indexes, and model routing together. Rolling back only code leaves incompatible state.

Record a release manifest covering every component and migration. Design backward-compatible changes or paired rollback steps.

Canaries compare the new manifest against the old under real traffic. Promotion should require both operational health and quality evidence.
common_mistakes: Unit tests alone cover every AI behavior change.
Prompt versions need not be recorded.
Rollback always means changing only application code.
mini_exercise: Draw “Promote with Evidence and Roll Back with State” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: AI delivery pipelines test code, prompts, models, data contracts, and safety before controlled release.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Promote with Evidence and Roll Back with State” to explain CI/CD for AI Apps plainly.
